goal: Add `--redact` / `--redact-policy <name-or-dotted-path>` / `--raw` / `--dry-run` / `--redact-salt` flags to `python -m flywheel.audit`, redacting by default with a one-line stderr notice.

references: src/flywheel/audit/_cli.py -- preview and --json rendering both read record.payload; redaction must precede both
constraints: The CLI redacts by default: it builds default_policy() composed with an EnvValueRedactor seeded from the ambient ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and prints `redaction: default policy applied (use --raw for verbatim)` to stderr exactly once (FR-10).
Redaction is applied identically to default and --json output so NDJSON consumers get redacted JSON (FR-10).

--redact-policy resolves a built-in by short name OR a Redactor-returning callable at a dotted path of the form `module.sub:factory`; resolution failures (no such module/attribute, wrong return type) fail fast with a clear error before streaming (FR-11).
Ship two named policies: `default` and `strict` (= default plus a tool-denylist for credential-reading tools).
--raw disables redaction and restores prior verbatim output exactly; it is a bare flag with no env gate (NFR-4).
--redact-salt <salt> enables salted [REDACTED:label:digest] tokens; default none yields bare tokens.

--dry-run streams the run through the selected policy and emits a coverage summary -- total records scanned, records with >=1 redaction, and per-redactor/per-pattern hit counts -- without printing any payload content (FR-12).
The stderr notice and --help text state plainly that redaction is best-effort, unmatched secrets can still pass through, and the store remains the unredacted source of truth (NFR-1).

SHARED-INVARIANT: existing CLI tests in tests/test_audit.py assert the CLI's verbatim default output. Redact-by-default changes that default -- update every such test in the SAME commit (assert the redacted output, or pass --raw where verbatim is the intent) so the suite stays green.
Call mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on src/flywheel/audit/_cli.py and fix all type errors before verify.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No new redactor types beyond composing existing ones from flywheel.redaction.
Do not change stream/subscribe/attach_logger signatures (done in audit-stream-redaction).
edge_cases: A malformed regex in a custom dotted-path policy fails fast at construction, never mid-stream.
--dry-run must emit zero payload content even when records contain no secrets.
